newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES MIXED AHEAD OF EASTER.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES MIXED AHEAD OF EASTER.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted marginally firmer on the U.S. dollar but weaker on other currencies when the interbank closed early at midday on Thursday, ahead of the Easter break, dealers said.
"It was a very quiet day, and the dollar didn't move much," one dealer said.
Earlier in the morning, one dealer said most market players were reluctant to take any position ahead of the holidays.
The local unit finished the day at 11.2600/2700 against the U.S. dollar, slightly up from Wednesday's 11.2650/2750 but eased to 18.3400/3600 from 18.2850/3130 versus sterling.
It was also quoted softer on the mark at 6.6900/7100 compared to 6.6580/6660 and was at 2.5500/5700 from 2.5440/5480 against South Africa's rand.
